description: Step 3 of the Tango working agreement (own it). Atomically claim the next task waiting for this worker — work assigned to it by name first (status 'assigned', with or without a role), then unclaimed queued work matching its roles. Returns the leased task; call get_task next for the full context bundle before starting work.

lease_seconds.description: Lease duration in seconds (default 2700 = 45 min, max 14400 = 4 h).

worker_id.description: Optional. Defaults to the worker bound to this MCP connection (one worker per harness).

name: pull_next_task
title: Claim the next available task
